# X4 — the grid of authored forms, re-derived from the code

Produced by `stand-enumerate-forms.php`, which reads the types rather than the
prose. It re-derives §2 of `measurement-directive-forms.md` for the stand, so
that the stand's grid rests on a run of this tree and not on a table copied
from an earlier one.

Subject channel: `annotation.unused-directive`.

## Axis "tag"

`SuppressionType::cases()` -> 3: `symbol`, `next-line`, `file`.
Where a directive is written does not add a form: the type is fixed by the tag,
not by the place (`SuppressionExtractor::PATTERN_SYMBOL/NEXT_LINE/FILE`). The
stand carries case `S-method` — a symbol form in a method docblock instead of a
class one — to check that by execution rather than by reading.

## Axis "level"

`SymbolLevel::cases()` -> 5: `callable`, `class`, `file`, `namespace`, `project`.
The channel is declared at: `file`.
Every other level is a pair the channel does not report at.

## Axis "no rule filter"

- `*` -> every channel
- `(omitted argument)` -> every channel

Both spellings desugar into `SuppressionTarget::NO_RULE_FILTER`, so the axis
contributes one form per tag, not two.

## The grid

3 tags x (2 selectors x (no level + 5 levels) + 1 form without a filter) = 3 x 13 = **39**.

The `@qmx-threshold` family is a fourth tag, but it addresses a **rule**, not a
channel, so it is not part of the suppression grid; the stand measures both of
its forms separately (`TH-channel`, `TH-producer`).

## The blind spot, named on the same line as the claim

The grid enumerates **forms that address the channel**. It does **not**
enumerate compositions of several directives in one file: one directive masking
another, two forms addressing the same finding, a file form and a next-line form
competing for one line. Every case carries at most one directive under test plus
the fixed victim, and that pair is the only composition the stand observes.
